policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O IPO timing questioned; safety cited
items.summary: Axios reports Sam Altman said O is delaying an IPO, attributing timing concerns to AI safety work. This can reduce near-term public-capital optionality despite ongoing product momentum.

items.headline: O regulators: senators scrutinize incident
items.summary: AP reports bipartisan senators questioned O over the Hugging Face incident and related controls. Heightened oversight could increase compliance costs and constrain product iteration, but no immediate sanction is stated.

items.headline: O enterprise: ChatGPT for Financial Services launched
items.summary: O’s release announces “ChatGPT for Financial Services,” positioning a vertical deployment for finance workflows. Likely supports revenue growth by deepening enterprise adoption, but execution risk remains.

items.headline: G raises $350M Series A
items.summary: G’s newsroom says it closed a $350M Series A, bringing 2026 funding to $1B. This supports capacity build for its inference cloud, strengthening run-rate expectations.
